title: lycopodium complanatum subsp. issleri
intro: Lycopodium complanatum subsp. issleri, commonly known as a subspecies of the club moss, is a type of plant that belongs to the Lycopodiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodium complanatum subsp. issleri include its ability to act as a stimulant and a diuretic, which can help to increase urine production and relieve symptoms associated with urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as lycoposine and isslerine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
